title: Admin panel in German, English and Thai

state.product: Zenno: booking + gift card SaaS for German wellness/massage studios, many run by Thai owners. First live shop SATUUU99. Customer booking pages and emails already support en/de/th via businesses.language (one language per shop).
state.request: Owner (2026-10-14): admin panels should be available in Thai; owners mostly speak German, English and Thai. Different people in the same shop may prefer different languages.
state.codebase: Admin UI is 64 React files, ~25k lines, all hard-coded English, no i18n library. Booking pages use a small in-house pattern: per-component text tables Record<'en'|'de'|'th', T> plus useBookingText(). Largest admin files: LoyaltyRewards 1.6k, Services 1.1k, Products, BookingFormAppearance, GeneralSettings, TaxReports, TeamManagement ~0.8-1k lines each.
state.effort: Infrastructure + language picker ~1 h. Daily screens (sidebar/nav, dashboard, calendar, bookings list, create/edit booking, customers, gift card station/orders, login) ~1 day. All remaining settings/reports/loyalty/products/team ~2 more days.
state.constraints: One developer (Claude). SATUUU99 is live and its staff use the daily screens. Untranslated screens fall back to English.

storage.instructions: Where is the admin language choice stored?

criteria.per_user_db: Per admin user in admin_users.ui_language (follows them across devices), default from browser language, picker in the sidebar.
criteria.per_browser: localStorage only, default from browser language.

criteria.daily_first: Ship infrastructure + picker + the daily screens first, then translate the rest screen by screen in follow-up rounds.
criteria.all_at_once: Translate all 64 files before shipping anything.

criteria.reuse_inhouse: Reuse the existing in-house pattern (typed per-component text tables, useAdminText hook), no new dependency.
criteria.i18next: Add react-i18next with JSON resource files.
